description: Repo-wide non-regression steps. Tiers: unit ⊂ default ⊂ full. Integration steps use {profile} (default: defaultProfile). Choose the store with --storage sql|filesystem|indexedDb|mongodb (profile emulatedServer-<storage>) or a profile with --profile. Steps with requires=storage need the store of the run (#390).

scopes.always: Run bracket (environment record, tracked-assets check): joins every scoped run
scopes.smoke: Wide and thin: one step per layer (model validation, transformers, DomainController, runner, report, UI component)
scopes.core: miroir-core unit catalog, transformers, queries, schemas, deployment modelValidation, access and authentication
scopes.actions: DomainController, persistence stores, model evolution (CRUD, undo/redo, freeze, drop)
scopes.runners: Runners, MCP runners, scenarios, multistep processes
scopes.ui: React components, reports, Miroir Tests UI, grids and list displays
scopes.localcache: Local cache memory measure and monitor
scopes.external: External services, OpenAPI connection wizard, secrets, process capabilities, AI backend
scopes.tooling: Repo guards, test harness and launchers, build tooling, runtimes (env, CLI, MCP, Electron)
